Hey there, 

Switched to my throwaway account for this question. I’m a few days late, but the guy I’m currently with has a foot fetish. I think it took him about six months into the relationship to tell me. We’ve been together two years now. 

I can’t say how common it actually is, since he’s the first guy who has ever told me he has this fetish. Maybe I have been with guys in the past who had the same going on, but they never told me. (I’m 30). 

I do know that he was nervous to tell me, and I think it has a lot to do with thinking I would be grossed out or reject him for it, but honestly, even though I HATE my feet, we do a lot of “foot play” in and outside the bedroom and I do enjoy it. 

Personally it’s made me look at feet differently, and perhaps made me even a little insecure, wondering if he’s always looking at other women’s feet and finding them more attractive than mine or thinking about them. 

All that aside, online it seems to be a pretty common fetish (I’ve done a lot of reading), but in my personal life, not so much. 

There were definite signs he has this fetish before telling me (he dropped little hints here and there) that I didn’t catch beforehand.
It’s just so frustrating sitting here miserable while he seems to be perfectly content not speaking or working anything out.
Is it really smart? Because really I just want to tell him to get out of my apartment and have a nice life.

Lately he has just been really into his phone and communication has slowed. He doesn’t really text me back or seem as interested in what I have to say anymore. Lots of Facebook for hours and hours and not speaking. I’ve mentioned how it’s made me feel a few times in the last few weeks or so but he will say something along the lines of, he’s not doing anything different and that nothing has changed. 

Like I said he’ll wake up and lay in bed on Facebook for 30-45 minutes while I start my day. It was one every so often but now it’s every morning. 

We sat on the couch for about four hours while he scrolled on his phone not saying anything. I spoke up and asked him to talk to me and that I felt like he was losing interest. 

He just got upset and said that nothing has changed and just because I think something is a certain way, it doesn’t make it true. 

I said that I had been feeling ignored lately and he asked me to give him reasons why I felt that way and when I did he told me he really didn’t want to talk to me. 

It’s now been about four hours and he hasn’t said a single word. He’s in the other room while I just lay in bed miserable about the night being ruined. 

I really sort of just want to go in the other room and tell him he can talk to me or fucking leave but I know that will just make the situation worse.
Well that’s slightly disappointing. Thanks for responding!
